meta.source: a Meta launch film for VR glasses (86 s)
meta.boards: boards/sNN.jpg per shot; boards/sNNa.jpg / sNNb.jpg = start / end for shots with a move or a big change

acts.name: Tease and reveal
acts.function: Out of black: three dark product macros (band horizon, puck mesh, a lens waking up), then a slow pull back to the centred hero and the name. 0-20.63 s.

acts.name: Cinema at home
acts.function: A hand takes the glasses from the table; he puts them on and asks for a film; the loft becomes a giant cinema. 20.63-34.67 s.

acts.name: Design interlude
acts.function: Two studio macros: hinge and puck. 34.67-39.42 s.

acts.name: Work and play in the cafe
acts.function: Brightest act: virtual keyboard, floating windows, app icons, gaze navigation; he lifts the glasses and greets a friend. 39.42-52.38 s.

acts.name: Sports anywhere
acts.function: Airport gate; a passer-by wipe turns the gate into courtside; the gate seats stand on the court. 52.38-62.29 s.

acts.name: Sound and scale
acts.function: Profile, spatial audio macro, night flight, giant theatre. 62.29-72.58 s.

acts.name: Hero and end card
acts.function: Upright puck pulls back to the band, the floating hero with the cable and the name, then the end card over the final lyric and silence. 72.58-86.04 s.

shots.subject_in_frame: Only the glasses' top band, seen head-on from just below the front: the dark band and visor fill the lower 58% of the frame as one black dome whose top edge is a shallow arc spanning the full width (ends leave the frame at about 55% height, peak at about 42% height, centred). Above the arc: black, with a warm glow hugging the arc. Like a planet horizon.
shots.camera: Eye level with the top band, square to the front, long lens, very shallow depth of field (only the rim is sharp).
shots.camera_move: Very slow push in with a slight rise: the arc sinks about 3% of the frame height over the shot; nothing else moves.
shots.action: 0-1.25 s pure black (fade from black). 1.25-3 s a faint amber glow appears above the arc at centre and spreads along it. About 3.5 s tiny pinpoint sensor dots along the band catch light near both ends. 5-6.38 s the thin silver top rim of the band lights as a fine bright line and the small Meta infinity logo becomes just readable at top centre of the band.
shots.light: Low key. One warm amber-bronze light from behind/above the product; a bronze glow sits low in the frame and falls off to near-black at the top and sides; no front fill, no haze, no smoke, no dust, no floor texture. Measured brightness 2 / 11 / 26: almost black for the whole shot; the only light is the rim and the glow behind the arc.
shots.audio: 0-2.3 s silence. From 2.5 s a low warm synth drone fades up (short-term loudness -32 LUFS at 3 s to -25 at 6 s). No speech. All in score.wav.
shots.render: First + last frame: plate A (band arc, glow only, logo invisible) -> plate B (same framing 3% lower, rim lit, logo readable), both made from set/product_glasses_sheet.jpg + set/loc_studio_void.jpg, then darkened to the measured 2-26. Fade from black 0-1.25 s in assembly. Glasses: follow the PRODUCT LOCK in set.product_glasses (sleek shield, ~3 cm deep, never a headset).

shots.subject_in_frame: Frame filled by the puck's dark brown-black perforated speaker mesh, curving like a dune from lower left to upper right; a smooth satin rim runs along the bottom-left as a curved band (lower 25% of frame); a raised smooth ring edge at the right third (x 70-100%). Top-right corner falls to black.

shots.camera_move: Slow lateral slide to the left with a slight push: about 5% of the frame width over 1.75 s; the ring edge drifts right.
shots.action: Light rakes across the mesh texture as the camera slides. No other change.
shots.light: Low key. One warm amber-bronze light from behind/above the product; a bronze glow sits low in the frame and falls off to near-black at the top and sides; no front fill, no haze, no smoke, no dust, no floor texture. Warm raking side light from the upper left. Brightness 19 / 26 / 29.
shots.audio: Drone continues with a soft high shimmer rising (about -21 LUFS short-term). No speech.
shots.render: Image to video from one plate (set/product_puck_sheet.jpg mesh detail on set/loc_studio_void.jpg), slow slide.

shots.subject_in_frame: One oval lens of the visor with its thin metal rim, left of centre and tilted (about 50% of the frame width, centred at x 45%, y 45%), resting against the dark mesh dome which fills the lower half; a round black nose pad at the upper left of the lens. The right third and the top are black.
shots.camera: Close, slightly above and to the right of the lens, macro lens, shallow depth of field.
shots.camera_move: Slow push in of about 10% with a slight drift right; the lens grows.
shots.action: 8.13-9.0 s the lens is dark, only a thin rim highlight. From about 9.0 s a soft iridescent light blooms inside the lens: a pearl-white core with peach, pink and violet-blue edges, like a display waking. It reaches full strength by about 10 s and holds. The bloom stays inside the lens; it is not a rainbow flare.
shots.light: Low key. One warm amber-bronze light from behind/above the product; a bronze glow sits low in the frame and falls off to near-black at the top and sides; no front fill, no haze, no smoke, no dust, no floor texture. The lens glow becomes the key light on the rim. Brightness 6 / 28 / 47.
shots.audio: Shimmer rises; percussion begins to build toward the beat at about 12.5 s. No speech.

shots.subject_in_frame: Start: extreme close-up silhouette: the top band's upper edge is a thin lit grey arc across the full width at about 30-38% height; below it the visor is a black mass with the nose-bridge cut-out and two nose pads at bottom centre. End: medium product shot, the glasses floating centred, 65% of the frame width (x 17-81%), top of the band at 37% height, the temple arms running down out of the bottom edge; the text sits above in the empty top third.
shots.camera: Front-on, slightly above the glasses' eye line looking straight at the visor, normal-to-long lens, deep enough focus to hold the whole glasses at the end.
shots.camera_move: Slow continuous pull back (dolly out) with a slight rise for the whole 8.79 s: the glasses go from overfilling the frame to 80% width at about 14.8 s and 65% at the end.
shots.action: The glasses float still, centred. The band catches light first; the visor stays glossy black with soft reflections. Text fades in over the top (see text).
shots.light: Low key. One warm amber-bronze light from behind/above the product; a bronze glow sits low in the frame and falls off to near-black at the top and sides; no front fill, no haze, no smoke, no dust, no floor texture. Soft top light grazes the band; faint bronze glow below and behind. Brightness 12 / 20 / 25: the reveal stays dark. The band is warm mid-grey, not white: at the end framing its mean is #5F5954 (luma 85-95); the visor is glossy black #0B0A08 (luma ~10) with soft reflections, never see-through.

shots.out: hard cut (the line carries across the cut into shot 7)
shots.audio: Sung lyric 23.55-25.4 s: 'I'll find another way'. Spoken line (his own voice, on camera, starts in this shot): 'Hey Meta, play the movie.' from 25.90 s to about 27.9 s, across the 26.63 cut. In the source score the first three words run 25.90-27.10 s and the film title that followed is muted (27.10-27.90 s) in set/score.wav: lay the new title words there.
shots.render: Keyframe mode: first_frame = plate of him on the loft sofa (HOME wardrobe) + guide_audio = a wav with set/lines/L01.wav placed at 2.81 s (its 25.90 start minus the 23.17 shot start, lips start 25.98 s). This holds the framing and the lip timing. If his face drifts from char_man, re-render with the same plate and guide audio; do not switch to reference mode (it ignores the first frame). Glasses on his face: match set/char_man_glasses_on.jpg (shield sunglasses size, no headset bulk).

shots.subject_in_frame: Symmetrical wide from behind the sofa: the long tufted sofa back runs across the bottom 30% of the frame; the man's head and shoulders at exact centre just above it (head about 6% of the width, at x 47-53%, y 57-66%); windows on the left wall, brick and a round art piece on the right wall, a low sideboard with lamps under the far wall. From 28.1 s a floating curved screen panel: x 12-86% of the width; top edge at 18.0% at the corners and 20.0% in the middle (it bows down: the panel wraps toward him); bottom edge 73.5% at the corners, 74.3% in the middle, just above the sofa back; corner radius 1.4% of the width; 2.39:1 film inside. Layer: set/ui_loft_screen_s07.png. The man and the sofa back are in front of the panel (see set/fx_loft_foreground_matte.jpg).
shots.camera: Behind the sofa at seated head height, square to the far wall, wide-normal lens, deep focus.
shots.action: 26.63-27.79 s dusky warm loft, no screen; the assistant pill (set/ui_assistant_pill.png: 7 capsules, pink #C57CBE and violet #AC7ACB, x 48.4-52.8%, y 31.7-33.6%) pulses with his voice. 27.79-28.10 s the screen pops in: opacity 0->1 linear over 0.31 s (7-8 frames) and scale 0.94->1.00 about the panel centre (x 49%, y 46%), ease-out; the brightest parts (ceiling lamps, visor line) read first; the pill fades out 27.77-27.85. The film: the generic sci-fi film, a helmeted commander on a platform between two loader arms (set/screen_film_scifi.jpg). 3D pop-out: the right loader arm reaches past the panel's right edge to x 97%, the left one to x 10%; the helmet top rises 3% above the top edge. The room goes cool and dim; he sits still. 28.1-30.2 s a slow push in of 3% (linear).
shots.light: Before the screen: warm dusk light in the windows, practical lamps on the sideboard. After: the screen is the key light, cool grey with a red accent; the room falls dark. Brightness 40 / 36 / 34. The sofa is muted sand-tan boucle (#5B4C36 in daylight), not cream.

text.words: (two lines of tiny grey legal text, generic wording)

shots.audio: End of the line (the title words, 27.10-27.90 s; slot). Music swells to about -15 LUFS short-term by 31 s; faint film sound effects bleed in under it.
shots.render: Built from two takes and a layer (see build).
build: 1. Plate A: loc_loft_living_room from behind the sofa (board s07a), warm dusk, brightness 40; the man centred, back to camera, HOME wardrobe.
2. Take A: keyframe mode, first_frame = plate A, 4 s, locked off, he sits still (his line is heard, his face is not seen).

3. Plate B: plate A with set/ui_loft_screen_s07.png laid on (as is, full frame), the room graded 25% darker and cooler (brightness 34) except the screen; check the panel edges sit as in subject_in_frame.

4. Take B: keyframe mode, first_frame = plate B, 3 s, locked off, 'the film plays on the floating screen, he watches'. If the model moves or warps the panel, render plate B without the panel (dark room only) and lay the layer in post.
5. Pill: over take A lay set/ui_assistant_pill.png from the shot start; scale each capsule's height between 40% and 100% at 6-9 Hz while he speaks (25.98-27.80); fade it out 27.77-27.85.
6. Pop: dissolve take A -> take B over 27.79-28.10 (0.31 s). Over the same 0.31 s the panel layer scales 0.94 -> 1.00 about (x 49%, y 46%), ease-out, opacity 0 -> 1 linear.

7. Pop-out: copy each loader arm out of set/screen_film_scifi.jpg and lay it straddling the panel side edge, scaled until the right arm's tip reaches x 97% and the left x 10% (about 1.3x the arm's size inside the panel), from 28.05 s; each arm's part outside the panel is over the dark wall, its part inside covers the panel's own arm.

8. Depth order, back to front: room -> screen panel -> pop-out arms / helmet -> the man and the sofa. The panel's bottom edge (73.5-74.3%) sits just above the sofa back (top edge 75%), and his head (x 46.6-51.3%, from y 56%) and shoulders (x 43-55%, from y 64%) overlap the panel: they must stay in front of it. Key them from your own plate A (set/fx_loft_foreground_matte.jpg gives the shape and place) and lay the matte over every panel layer.
9. 28.10 -> end: scale the whole picture 1.00 -> 1.03 linear (slow push).

shots.render: One take on a composite plate (see build).
build: 1. Plate: plate A of shot 7 (back of sofa, dark cool room, brightness 40) with set/ui_loft_screen_s09.png laid on full frame; the pop-out helmet crown is part of that layer.
2. Take: keyframe mode, first_frame = that plate, 3 s, 'the helmeted figure on the screen turns its head slowly about 10 degrees to the left; the man and the room stay still'.
3. If the take blurs the crown or moves the panel edge: render the plate without the layer (dark room) and lay the layer in post, animating only a 1.5% horizontal slide of the film inside the panel.

4. Depth order, back to front: room -> screen panel -> pop-out arms / helmet -> the man and the sofa. The panel's bottom edge (73.5-74.3%) sits just above the sofa back (top edge 75%), and his head (x 46.6-51.3%, from y 56%) and shoulders (x 43-55%, from y 64%) overlap the panel: they must stay in front of it. Key them from your own plate A (set/fx_loft_foreground_matte.jpg gives the shape and place) and lay the matte over every panel layer.
5. Push in 1.00 -> 1.05 (linear over the shot) on the composite. Caption from set/text_captions.jpg.

build: Three takes, all seated eye height side-on, locked off; two body wipes made from set/fx_passerby_matte.jpg (black body on white: invert it for the alpha).
Take A (gate, board s21a): he sits right of centre (x 45-70%), glasses in his hands, lifts them toward his face. Used 53.71-55.52.
Take B (gate, same plate): he puts the glasses on (first_frame = take A's plate with the glasses at his face). Used 55.60-56.15.

Wipe 1 (A -> B): passer-by 1 = the matte scaled to 1.3x the frame height, body colour #0A0A0A, edge feather 2% of the width, motion blur 3%. It crosses right to left: its leading (left) edge runs x 100% -> 0% over 55.27-55.52; the frame is fully dark 55.52-55.60; its trailing edge runs x 100% -> 0% over 55.60-55.85 and uncovers take B behind it.

Wipe 2 (B -> C): passer-by 2 = the matte at 1.0x frame height, the same colour. Leading edge x 100% -> 0% over 56.02-56.15 (covering take B); trailing edge x 100% -> 70% (56.18) -> 55% (56.27-56.35) -> 30% (56.43) -> 0% (56.50). Right of the trailing edge shows take C, so the court is revealed right to left behind the body.
Mid-wipe brightness drops to 29 (the measured mid value is the dark body, not a grade target). Grade takes A/B to 87 and take C to 76.

cut30.arc: Hook (0-5.6): the lens wakes in the dark, the beat drops on the hero, INTRODUCING + name. Middle (5.6-22.5): two payoffs, each a place that turns bigger: the loft (he takes the glasses, 'Hey Meta, play the movie.', the screen pops in, 3D cinema) and the gate (body wipes to courtside, play-by-play, IMMERSIVE SPORTS). Payoff and end card (22.5-30): the floating hero with the name, dissolve to SEE HOW IT FEELS / SPRING 2027 over 'Keep moving'. The cafe, design macros, plane and theatre acts are left out.
